about_the_game:
Welcome to Habbo Hotel : Origins
Step back into a vibrant pixel universe where familiar faces and fresh surprises await. Remember that first rush of logging on, choosing your avatar’s hairstyle, then racing through crowded lobbies? You’ll feel it all over again—only bigger and with brand-new twists.

Your Pixel Self, Your Rules
Ever wondered how far your creativity can stretch? Slip into hundreds of new outfits, mix ’n’ match classic looks, then head to our revamped fashion studio. It’s casual, it’s bold, and it’s entirely you.

Build, Share, Repeat
• Design cozy lounges or epic party halls with fresh furniture packs
• Show off your space in community showcases
• Trade rare items in friendly marketplaces

Here’s the thing: whether you’re crafting a chill corner for friends or an over-the-top dance floor, the tools are out there. Think retro vibes paired with modern flair—so you never feel boxed in.

Live Events That Keep You Guessing
You know what’s fun? Spontaneous quests, surprise DJ sets, and pixel treasure hunts. Our calendar is always packed. Join a midnight rave one day, then team up for a build-off the next. It’s social gaming without the fuss.

Why Habbo Hotel : Origins?
Honestly, it’s more than nostalgia. It’s a living, breathing community that evolves every season. Whether you’re reconnecting with old pals or making new ones, there’s always a reason to log back in.

Ready to Jump In?
Install now and claim your free Steam starter pack (Nameplate & Steam Crank!), once you've reached level 15 in either the fishing or gardening skill! Your pixel playground is open 24/7 and waiting for you. See you in the lobby!

content_descriptors.notes:
Although Habbo Hotel : Origins contains no graphic violence, gore, or explicit sexual content, it is rated 18+ and designed for an adult audience. All “conflict” is playful—think pillow fights or harmless pranks—with no combat system, blood, or injury depicted. Avatars may wear swimwear or lounge attire, but there is no nudity or sexual acts shown.

Because it’s a live-service social MMO, user chat can sometimes feature strong language, suggestive banter, or mature role-play. Virtual venues often include decorative bar counters and pixel “drinks,” but there is no real substance-use mechanics or intoxication effects. We do not depict sexual assault, non-consensual acts, self-harm, or drug abuse in any storyline or event.

To maintain a safe environment for our adult community, we employ AI-driven moderation alongside block/ignore/report tools—so you remain in control of your social space. 

Only for players aged 18 and up who are comfortable with open chat and user-generated content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 2.0 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with DirectX 9.0c (or OpenGL 3.0) support
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with DirectX 11 (or OpenGL 4.1) support
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A pixel-art social simulation MMO where you customize your avatar, build and decorate rooms, trade rare items, and join live community events in a nostalgic yet ever-evolving virtual world.
